WorkspaceRecord.title: WorkspaceRecord
WorkspaceRecord.description: Saved Gemini AI execution output or multi-AI collaboration transcript owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

toolId.description: Identifier of the Gemini AI capability or AI_COLLAB_SESSION.

modelEndpoint.description: Model and capability label used for the generation.

prompt.description: Input prompt or discussion topic submitted by the user.

responseText.description: Generated AI response or collaboration transcript.

metadataSummary.description: Optional summary such as token usage or message count.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon write.

DirectiveConfig.title: DirectiveConfig
DirectiveConfig.description: Independent Common Directive and Per-AI Individual Directives configuration for a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

commonDirective.description: Global directive applied independently across all participating AIs.

useCommonDirective.description: Toggle enabling or disabling the global common directive.

individualDirectives.description: Map of GeminiToolType name to per-AI individual directive text.

individualEnabledMap.description: Map of GeminiToolType name to boolean toggle for each AI individual directive.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon write.

/users/{userId}/workspaceRecords/{record.description: User-owned collection of saved AI execution outputs and multi-AI collaboration transcripts.

/users/{userId}/directiveConfigs/{config.description: User-owned configuration storing independent Common and Per-AI Individual directives.
